# Start your first conversation

# Start your first conversation

Open [Counso AI](https://app.counso.ai) and go to **Work**. Click the new conversation button (**Create a new conversation**).

## Before you send a request

1. Check the selected Agent. Choose another one if the task needs a different set of instructions or access.
2. Write the outcome you want in one or two sentences.
3. Add the context the Agent needs, such as the relevant text or a file you are allowed to use.
4. Review the available model control and choose an option your workspace provides.

Start with a small task that is easy to check. For example, ask the Agent to summarise a short document and list the points that need your attention. Avoid including passwords, access tokens, or information you are not authorised to share.

Click **Send message** when the request is ready. The Agent may ask a follow-up question or return an answer. Read the answer against the source material, check names, numbers, dates, and requested actions, and correct the request if the context was incomplete.

## When the answer involves an action

An answer can describe a proposed action without proving that an external service accepted it. If the task could change a record, send a message, publish content, or incur a charge, confirm the intended action before proceeding and check the destination system afterwards. Keep a record of the result you actually verified.

Available models, tools, and data depend on workspace configuration and permissions. If an Agent or model is missing, ask your workspace administrator to check access. Continue with a smaller, read-only question while you clarify the setup.

For the workspace layout, read [Workspace navigation](/en/getting-started/workspace-navigation/#workspace-navigation). To choose an Agent before starting, read [Choose an Agent](/en/agents/choose-an-agent/#choose-an-agent).
